summary: Renders the media-buffer playback list for the current playback index. Caches per-item layout coordinates (X from sub_487060, Y/size from sub_4870E0) for indices 0-3 into this+0x108..0x124, positions the list iterator on the current node (this[60]) at the clamped index (this[63]), resolves the node's display string (falling back to byte_5EA438), looks it up in the string table via BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC, computes item layout with ShortComputation_4f00, and dispatches a UI message (UIMessageDispatch). For playback states 3/4/5/8/9 (ShortComputation_6720) it additionally walks the list to a target index (this[64]), then renders extra items (index >= 4) in a do-while loop with clip-bounds hit testing (DualFieldRead outputs) that selects UIStringAccessor_62e0 for in-bounds items and tracks the selected index in this[65]. Ends with a ConditionalDelegation_6460 call on this[33]; when non-null, fills a surface region from the delegated object's rect and invokes vtable entry #4 (render), then calls vtable entry #11 (cleanup) and returns 0.
